abstract: International sanctions have been increasingly deployed for political and economic reasons. While the consequences of sanctions on political and macro‐economic outcomes are well‐analysed, rigorous evaluations of the causal impacts of sanctions on the agriculture and food (agri‐food) trade remain limited. We obtain the causal estimates of sanctions' impact on agri‐food trade by utilising samples that have been threatened with but not subject to sanctions to construct the counterfactual of the sanctioned sample. Exploiting an event study approach to analyse data from 154 countries over the period 1960–2016, we find that international sanctions mostly resulted in modest and short‐lived declines in the total agri‐food trade of sanctioned countries as opposed to the counterpart of countries under sanction threats. Trade volumes declined substantially for beef, pork, roots, dairy and fruit products. The decline in the exports of agri‐food commodities resulting from international sanctions was more significant relative to the drop in imports. The study also reveals that the impact of sanctions on agri‐food trade depends partially on the type of the sanction and on the sanction imposer. While the differences in the impact of sanctions across agri‐food commodities largely reflect the fact that the commodities where there are stronger impacts are those produced more in countries subject to sanctions, future studies incorporating analytical tools from industrial organisation may provide more nuanced insights on why and how the trade of differential agri‐food commodities was impacted by sanctions so differently.
abstract_zh: 国际制裁日益频繁地被用于政治和经济目的。尽管制裁对政治和宏观经济结果的影响已被充分分析，但关于制裁对农业与食品（农食）贸易因果影响的严谨评估仍然有限。我们通过利用曾受到制裁威胁但未实际遭受制裁的样本，构建受制裁样本的反事实，从而获得制裁对农食贸易影响的因果估计。采用事件研究方法分析1960年至2016年间154个国家的数据，我们发现，与受到制裁威胁的国家相比，国际制裁大多导致受制裁国家农食总贸易量出现温和且短暂的下降。牛肉、猪肉、根茎类作物、乳制品和水果产品的贸易量显著减少。由国际制裁导致的农食商品出口下降相较于进口下降更为显著。研究还揭示，制裁对农食贸易的影响部分取决于制裁类型及实施制裁的主体。尽管不同农食商品间制裁影响的差异在很大程度上反映了受影响较大的商品正是受制裁国家生产较多的商品，但未来结合产业组织分析工具的研究可能为解释不同农食商品贸易为何及如何受到制裁如此不同的影响提供更为细致的见解。
title: Identifying the Causal Impacts of International Sanctions on Agricultural Trade: An Event Study Approach
title_zh: 识别国际制裁对农产品贸易的因果影响：一项事件研究法分析

abstract: This paper investigates the effect of a major judicial reform—the establishment of interprovincial circuit tribunals (ICTs)—on politically biased court outcomes. Using a unique data set of commercial civil cases involving listed firms in China and based on a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the ICTs effectively curb political favoritism in the judiciary, as evidenced by a significant decline in the win-rate disparity between politically connected and unconnected firms following the reform. The effects are more pronounced for firms connected to higher-ranking officials, those facing higher travel costs to appeal for retrial pre-reform, cases involving larger monetary stakes, and regions characterized by weaker legal environments. Moreover, the mechanism analysis suggests that the reform reshapes local courts’ incentives to yield to political interference through career concerns and the special petition mechanism. Finally, further analysis indicates that this judicial reform improves the quality of court decisions, enhances judicial accessibility, and mitigates local protectionism. Overall, the ICTs have significantly deterred political interference in court proceedings and contributed to a more impartial judicial environment in China.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一项重大司法改革——设立跨省巡回法庭（ICTs）——对政治偏颇的法院裁决结果的影响。利用涉及中国上市公司的商业民事案件独特数据集，并基于双重差分法，我们发现巡回法庭有效遏制了司法体系中的政治偏袒，这体现在改革后政治关联企业与非关联企业之间胜诉率差距显著缩小。这一效应在涉及更高级别官员关联的企业、改革前上诉再审旅行成本较高的企业、涉案金额较大的案件以及法治环境较弱的地区中更为显著。此外，机制分析表明，该改革通过职业顾虑和特殊信访机制重塑了地方法院屈服于政治干预的动机。最后，进一步分析显示，此项司法改革提升了法院裁决质量，增强了司法可及性，并缓解了地方保护主义。总体而言，巡回法庭显著遏制了法院程序中的政治干预，为中国更加公正的司法环境做出了贡献。

title: Loosen the ties that bind: interprovincial circuit tribunals, political interference, and judicial independence
title_zh: 松绑束缚：跨省巡回法庭、政治干预与司法独立

abstract: This paper examines the interactions between shocks to oil prices (demand, supply, and risks) and the federal funds rate and the MSCI World Climate Change Index (CLMT), a market-based measure of transition risk and green asset valuations, utilizing a cross-spectral coherency and a novel Quantile VAR extended joint connectedness, the research uncovers a noteworthy impact of oil price shocks on interdependence and volatility spillovers. Notably, the coherency outcomes indicate an inverse relationship between oil price shocks (demand, supply and risks) and Federal fund rates during oil price recession (OPR) and COVID-19 crisis period. Quantile connectedness analysis shows that spillover intensities vary across different quantiles and frequencies. Total connectedness surge during OPR and COVID-19 crisis period, highlighting the heightened market connectedness during crisis periods. The dynamic connectedness analysis signifies that volatility spillovers intensify during extreme quantiles, indicating rapid volatility propagation in highly volatile market conditions. These findings have significant implications for diverse stakeholders.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了油价冲击（需求、供给及风险）与联邦基金利率及MSCI世界气候变化指数（CLMT）——一种基于市场的转型风险与绿色资产估值指标——之间的相互作用，运用交叉谱相干性和一种新颖的分位数VAR扩展联合连通性方法，研究发现油价冲击对相互依赖性和波动溢出效应具有显著影响。值得注意的是，相干性结果表明，在油价衰退期（OPR）和COVID-19危机期间，油价冲击（需求、供给及风险）与联邦基金利率呈反向关系。分位数连通性分析显示，溢出强度在不同分位数和频率间存在差异。总连通性在OPR和COVID-19危机期间激增，凸显了危机时期市场连通性的增强。动态连通性分析表明，波动溢出在极端分位数下加剧，表明在高波动市场条件下波动传播迅速。这些发现对各类利益相关者具有重要启示意义。
title: Dynamics of oil price shocks and federal interest rates: a quantile based analysis during crisis period
title_zh: 石油价格冲击与联邦利率的动态关系：危机时期的分位数分析

abstract: This study examines how corporate green innovation is influenced by ultimate controlling shareholders, which we categorize into three institutional types: central government, local government, and private entities. Using 29,926 firm-year observations of A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2023 and panel fixed-effects models with industry-year and province-year joint fixed effects, we find that central state-owned enterprises (SOEs) significantly outperform others in green innovation willingness, quantity, and quality, while local SOEs and private enterprises show no significant difference. Mechanism tests reveal that central state-owned enterprises’ green innovation advantage is driven by greater social responsibility, whereas local state-owned enterprises’ regulatory bargaining power dampens their green innovation. Further analysis shows that central SOEs and local SOEs exhibit a stronger emphasis on non-R&D environmental transformation activities than private enterprises, suggesting differentiated compliance strategies across ownership types. These findings extend the ownership-innovation literature by demonstrating that the ownership hierarchy established for general innovation does not necessarily hold in the context of corporate green innovation, and provide new insights into the mechanisms through which state capitalism shapes firms’ green innovation. KEYWORDS: Green innovation state capitalism ultimate controlling shareholders responsible investment bargaining power JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 G34 M14 Acknowledgements The authors express their gratitude to Dr. Jing Zhang of Xiamen University of Technology for her insightful comments. Any remaining errors are solely our responsibility.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了终极控制股东如何影响企业绿色创新，我们将终极控制股东划分为三种制度类型：中央政府、地方政府和私人实体。基于2009年至2023年间A股上市公司29,926个公司-年度观测值，并采用行业-年份和省份-年份联合固定效应的面板固定效应模型，我们发现中央国有企业（SOEs）在绿色创新意愿、数量和质量上显著优于其他类型企业，而地方国有企业和私营企业之间则无显著差异。机制检验揭示，中央国有企业的绿色创新优势源于更强的社会责任承担，而地方国有企业的监管议价能力则抑制了其绿色创新。进一步分析表明，中央国有企业和地方国有企业在非研发环境转型活动上的重视程度高于私营企业，这表明不同所有权类型的企业采取了差异化的合规策略。这些发现拓展了所有权-创新文献，证明了为一般创新建立的所有权层级在绿色创新背景下并不必然成立，并为国家资本主义如何塑造企业绿色创新的机制提供了新的见解。关键词：绿色创新；国家资本主义；终极控制股东；责任投资；议价能力JEL分类：G32 G34 M14致谢：作者感谢厦门理工学院张静博士的 insightful 评论。文中任何错误均由我们自行承担。

title: Does state capitalism always lead corporate green technology innovation? Evidence from China
title_zh: 国家资本主义是否总能促进企业绿色技术创新？来自中国的证据

abstract: This study examines the relationship between unemployment, income inequality, and Africans’ expectations about future economic prospects, highlighting how structural exclusion and labour market inefficiencies shape perceived opportunities, optimism, and confidence. Using Afrobarometer individual-level survey data combined with country-level macroeconomic indicators, ordinary least squares estimates reveal that Africans’ expectations regarding their countries’ future economic prospects are more strongly and negatively associated with unemployment than with the level of income inequality prevailing in their countries. Specifically, a one-percentage-point increase in unemployment is associated with a 0.026-point decrease in respondents’ optimism expectations regarding economic outlook. In addition, there is limited evidence that inequality substantially moderates the relationship between unemployment and expectations. Robustness checks using ordered logit models, a leave-one-country-out exercise, and logit models, confirm the consistency of the findings. However, robustness checks based on aggregating individuals’ perceptions at country-year level data suggest that the relationship between unemployment, inequality, and economic expectations is primarily driven by individual-level variation, underscoring the importance of micro-level heterogeneity in studying perceptions of future economic conditions. The findings suggest that African policymakers should prioritize addressing unemployment challenges to restore optimism, even where inequality remains unresolved. KEYWORDS: Inequality unemployment expectations Africa JEL CLASSIFICATION: E24 D63 D84 O55 Acknowledgements This paper was presented at the 65th Annual Congress of the Canadian Society of Economic Science (SCSE) and at the 93rd Congress of French-Canadian Association for the Advancement of Science (ACFAS). The authors are grateful to participants and discussants for their valuable comments and suggestions, which helped improve the quality of this study.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了失业、收入不平等与非洲人对未来经济前景预期之间的关系，揭示了结构性排斥和劳动力市场低效如何塑造感知机会、乐观情绪和信心。利用非洲晴雨表个人层面调查数据，结合国家层面宏观经济指标，普通最小二乘估计显示，非洲人对本国未来经济前景的预期与失业率的负向关联强于与本国收入不平等水平的关联。具体而言，失业率每上升一个百分点，受访者对经济前景的乐观预期下降0.026个点。此外，仅有有限证据表明不平等显著调节失业与预期之间的关系。采用有序Logit模型、逐一剔除国家检验及Logit模型的稳健性检验证实了研究结果的一致性。然而，基于将个人感知聚合至国家-年份层面的稳健性检验表明，失业、不平等与经济预期之间的关系主要由个人层面变异驱动，凸显了微观层面异质性在研究未来经济条件感知中的重要性。研究结果表明，非洲政策制定者应优先解决失业挑战以恢复乐观情绪，即使不平等问题尚未解决。关键词：不平等；失业；预期；非洲 JEL分类：E24 D63 D84 O55 致谢 本文曾在加拿大经济科学学会（SCSE）第65届年会及法裔加拿大科学促进协会（ACFAS）第93届大会上报告。作者感谢与会者和评论人的宝贵意见与建议，这些帮助提升了本研究的质量。
title: Unemployment, inequality, and Africans’ expectations about future economic prospects
title_zh: 失业、不平等与非洲人对未来经济前景的预期

abstract: We introduce the nonlinear arbitrage correction (NAC), the residual that renders a linear benchmark model arbitrage-free while preserving the law of one price. The price of NAC captures the marginal Sharpe ratio increase consistent with no-arbitrage and upper-bounds the constrained Hansen–Jagannathan distance. Using four decades of international equity, currency, and factor returns, NAC is strongly countercyclical, peaking during crises when linear models turn negative. The implied Sharpe ratio increase reaches 0.3, underscoring its economic relevance. While linear models perform well on average, they fail in distressed states, underpricing nonlinear payoffs. Incorporating NAC restores positivity and stabilizes pricing across regimes. (JEL G11, G12, G15)
abstract_zh: 我们引入了非线性套利修正（NAC），这是一种残差，使得线性基准模型在保持一价定律的同时实现无套利。NAC的价格捕捉了与无套利相一致的边际夏普比率提升，并限制了受约束的Hansen-Jagannathan距离。利用四十年间的国际股票、货币和因子回报数据，NAC表现出强烈的逆周期性，在线性模型转为负值的危机期间达到峰值。隐含的夏普比率提升达到0.3，凸显了其经济重要性。尽管线性模型在平均情况下表现良好，但在困境状态下它们失效，低估了非线性收益。纳入NAC可恢复正性并稳定跨体制的定价。（JEL G11, G12, G15）
title: International Arbitrage Premia

abstract: Drug shortages affect most pharmaceutical markets. We develop a model of capacity choice for a firm supplying multiple countries under regulated prices, in which supply shocks generate shortages: the highest-price countries remain fully served, middle-price countries are rationed, and the lowest-price countries are excluded, so that domestic and foreign prices affect both the frequency and the magnitude of shortages. We then develop a method to detect shortages and measure their magnitude using only national sales data. Applying it to monthly pharmacy sales in France over 2019-2024, we find an average shortage probability of 26%. Higher French prices reduce both the probability and the magnitude of shortages in France. Higher UK prices reduce the probability of French shortages but increase their magnitude, while higher Polish prices reduce both, consistent with the capacity and allocation channels of the model. Counterfactuals on antipsychotics show that targeted price increases can substantially reduce shortages at limited expenditure cost.
abstract_zh: 药品短缺影响着大多数药品市场。我们构建了一个模型，研究在管制价格下，供应多个国家的企业在产能选择上的决策，其中供应冲击会导致短缺：价格最高的国家保持完全供应，价格中等的国家实行配给，而价格最低的国家则被排除在外，因此国内和国外价格同时影响短缺的频率和严重程度。随后，我们开发了一种仅利用国家销售数据来检测短缺并衡量其严重程度的方法。将该方法应用于2019-2024年法国月度药房销售数据，我们发现平均短缺概率为26%。法国价格的提高既降低了法国短缺的概率，也减轻了其严重程度。英国价格的提高降低了法国短缺的概率，但增加了其严重程度，而波兰价格的提高则同时降低了这两者，这与模型中的产能和分配渠道相一致。针对抗精神病药物的反事实分析表明，有针对性的价格上调可以在有限支出成本下大幅减少短缺。
title: Regulated Prices, Global Capacity, and Drug Shortages
title_zh: 管制价格、全球产能与药品短缺

title: The effect of disaster relief on climate adaptation: Evidence from floods in Pakistan
title_zh: 灾害救济对气候适应的影响：来自巴基斯坦洪水的证据

abstract: This paper studies the effects of wealth taxation on efficiency, equity, and welfare in a heterogeneous-agent model with incomplete markets and endogenous occupational and legal-form choice. Entrepreneurs choose between operating as pass-through businesses and C-corporations. While C-corporations face less favorable tax treatment and higher operating costs, they benefit from easier access to external finance. The choice of legal form therefore shapes both the after-tax return to entrepreneurial investment and the severity of financial constraints. Calibrating the model to the U.S. economy, we show that the effects of wealth taxation depend crucially on the endogenous reallocation of entrepreneurs across legal forms. Revenue-neutral reforms that encourage entrepreneurs to switch toward pass-through businesses tighten financial constraints, exacerbate capital misallocation within the entrepreneurial sector, and amplify the efficiency costs of wealth taxation. By contrast, reforms that encourage entrepreneurs to organize as C-corporations relax financial constraints, improve capital allocation, and can more than offset the aggregate distortions induced by the wealth tax. We further show that the distributional and welfare effects crucially depend on the design of the wealth tax itself. While a flat wealth tax does not lower wealth inequality, it generates aggregate welfare gains under all revenue-recycling schemes we consider. By contrast, a progressive wealth tax reduces inequality but may generate aggregate welfare losses because it more strongly discourages entrepreneurial investment.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全市场及内生职业与法律形式选择下的异质性主体模型中，财富税对效率、公平和福利的影响。企业家可以选择以穿透型企业或C型公司形式运营。尽管C型公司面临较不利的税收待遇和更高的运营成本，但它们更容易获得外部融资。因此，法律形式的选择既塑造了企业家投资的税后回报，也影响了金融约束的严重程度。通过将模型校准至美国经济，我们表明财富税的影响关键取决于企业家在法律形式间的内生重新配置。鼓励企业家转向穿透型企业的收入中性改革会收紧金融约束，加剧企业家部门内部的资本错配，并放大财富税的效率成本。相反，鼓励企业家组建C型公司的改革则能放松金融约束，改善资本配置，并可能超过财富税带来的总体扭曲。我们进一步表明，分配和福利效应关键取决于财富税本身的设计。虽然统一财富税并未降低财富不平等，但在我们考虑的所有收入循环方案下，它都能带来总体福利增益。相比之下，累进财富税减少了不平等，但可能因更强烈地抑制企业家投资而产生总体福利损失。
title: Wealth Tax, Entrepreneurship, and the Legal Form of Business Organization
title_zh: 财富税、创业精神与企业组织的法律形式

abstract: In the late 1800s, city leaders in the United States established red-light districts to contain prostitution. Progressive Era reformers argued these districts harmed public health, prompting their closure in the 1910s. This paper analyzes how closing the red-light districts affected neighborhood composition and public health. I find infant mortality from premature births and congenital defects increased after closure, which is consistent with an increase in congenital syphilis. There was also no increase in homicide deaths, suggesting the districts did not increase crime. These findings suggest the public health concerns raised by reformers were likely overstated.
abstract_zh: 19世纪末，美国城市领导者设立了红灯区以控制卖淫活动。进步时代改革者认为这些区域损害了公共健康，促使它们在1910年代被关闭。本文分析了关闭红灯区如何影响社区构成与公共健康。我发现，关闭后，因早产和先天缺陷导致的婴儿死亡率上升，这与先天性梅毒增加相符。同时，凶杀死亡并未增加，表明这些区域并未加剧犯罪。这些发现表明，改革者提出的公共健康担忧可能被夸大了。
title: The Progressive Era War on Vice: Public Health Consequences of Closing Red-Light Districts
title_zh: 进步时代对罪恶的战争：关闭红灯区对公共健康的影响

abstract: GLP-1 drugs have transformed the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity. As governments and insurers debate whether and how to cover GLP-1 drugs, much of the discussion focuses on health spending. But obesity and diabetes also impose costs through the labour market. Using linked Danish register data, this column examines whether people are more likely to work after beginning treatment and spend less time away because of illness. The findings reveal that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave, as well as emergency department visits and cardiovascular medication use.
abstract_zh: GLP-1药物已彻底改变了2型糖尿病和肥胖症的治疗方式。在政府和保险公司就如何及是否覆盖GLP-1药物展开辩论之际，讨论多聚焦于医疗支出。然而，肥胖和糖尿病也通过劳动力市场施加成本。利用丹麦关联登记数据，本专栏探讨了人们在开始治疗后是否更有可能工作，并减少因病缺勤的时间。研究结果显示，GLP-1治疗减少了长期病假，以及急诊就诊和心血管药物的使用。
authors: Meltem Daysal, Camille Fredrickson, Ida Lykke Kristiansen, Mircea Trandafir, Jonathan Zhang
title: GLP-1 treatment reduces sickness absence

abstract: Safe government bonds enjoy a discount known as the convenience yield. When a government issues more debt, it erodes this discount for itself and for other countries – a fiscal externality that incentivises excessive debt issuance. But safe asset issuers also have market power, and thus incentives to reduce issuance to boost the convenience yield and extract rents from foreign bondholders. This column studies these distortions under non-cooperative fiscal policy. Over the past decade, the fiscal externality has dominated in the euro area, fostering over-issuance of safe sovereign debt. This calls for fiscal coordination and restraint even absent debt sustainability concerns.
abstract_zh: 安全政府债券享有被称为便利收益的折扣。当政府发行更多债务时，它会侵蚀自身及其他国家的这一折扣——这是一种财政外部性，激励过度债务发行。然而，安全资产发行者也拥有市场力量，因此有动机减少发行以提高便利收益，并从外国债券持有者那里获取租金。本专栏在非合作财政政策下研究这些扭曲。过去十年中，财政外部性在欧元区占据主导地位，促进了安全主权债务的过度发行。这要求即便在没有债务可持续性担忧的情况下，也应进行财政协调与克制。
authors: Matthias Gnewuch, Matthieu Bellon, Luca Zavalloni
title: Safe debt financing: International spillovers and the benefits of fiscal policy coordination
title_zh: 安全债务融资：国际溢出效应与财政政策协调的收益

abstract: Institutions facilitate short-selling by lending from their holdings, but what they hold is endogenous. This paper examines how institutional demand, driven by investment mandates (benchmarking), affects short-selling. In a model where benchmarked managers lend from their holdings, both lending supply and equilibrium price are higher for the benchmark asset, and so is shorting demand (due to inflated price). A quasi-experiment using Russell index reconstitution shows that stocks with more benchmarked capital have greater lending supply and demand. Ultimately, such stocks are costlier to short. In theory and data, results are driven by incomplete pass-through from benchmarked capital to lending supply.
abstract_zh: 机构通过出借其持有的证券来促进卖空，但其持有量是内生的。本文考察了由投资授权（基准化）驱动的机构需求如何影响卖空行为。在一个基准化管理者出借其持有资产的模型中，基准资产的借贷供给和均衡价格均更高，卖空需求也随之增加（因价格被抬高）。利用罗素指数重构进行的准实验表明，基准化资本占比更高的股票具有更大的借贷供给和需求。最终，这类股票的卖空成本更高。在理论和数据中，这些结果均由基准化资本向借贷供给的不完全传导所驱动。
title: Institutional investor mandates, securities lending, and short-selling constraints
title_zh: 机构投资者委托、证券借贷与卖空约束

abstract: Simple theoretical models of job search can imply that a higher minimum wage increases the number of job seekers for affected jobs. Researchers often appeal to these models in defending or explaining non-negative estimated employment effects of minimum wages. We use novel data on job search in U.S. states to examine the effect of minimum wage increases on the number of job seekers for low-skilled positions. We find little if any evidence that higher minimum wages increase job search for low-skilled jobs, and more evidence that higher minimum wages decrease the number of workers seeking employment in these jobs.
abstract_zh: 简单的求职理论模型可能暗示，最低工资提高会增加受影响职位的求职者数量。研究者常引用这些模型来为最低工资的非负就业效应估计进行辩护或解释。我们利用美国各州关于求职的新数据，考察最低工资上调对低技能岗位求职者数量的影响。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明更高的最低工资会增加低技能工作的求职活动，反而有更多证据显示，更高的最低工资会减少寻求这些岗位就业的工人数量。
title: Minimum wage laws and job search
title_zh: 最低工资法与求职行为

abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of air pollutants is essential for supporting air-quality management and land-use planning. This study developed an exploratory XGBoost–GAN framework to reconstruct annual PM2.5 and NO2 surfaces and to examine model-indicated pollutant-pattern differences under land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin, China. Annual observations from 113 monitoring stations during 2014–2024 were combined with multi-source auxiliary rasters, including aerosol optical depth, meteorological variables, land-use/land-cover data, nighttime light, elevation, and population density. Random Forest, Long Short-Term Memory, and XGBoost models were trained using 2014–2023 data and independently evaluated using 2024 station observations. XGBoost achieved the best overall performance, with R² values of 0.71 and 0.81 for PM2.5 and NO2, respectively, and was therefore used to generate 1-km baseline pollutant surfaces for 2024. Two Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) models were then trained to translate land-use images into XGBoost-estimated pollutant maps, enabling scenario experiments involving plant, built-up land, and water-body configurations. Under the condition of exploratory mode response rather than causal analysis, the scenario analysis results indicate that multiple land use layouts are related to the local decrease in pollutant concentrations estimated by the model. This study provides a data-driven approach for joint pollutant mapping and preliminary screening of land-use planning scenarios, while highlighting the need for validation with observed land-use transitions in future work.
abstract_zh: 理解空气污染物的空间分布对于支持空气质量管理和土地利用规划至关重要。本研究开发了一种探索性的XGBoost–GAN框架，用于重建中国四川盆地年度PM2.5和NO2浓度表面，并检验在土地利用情景下模型指示的污染物格局差异。研究结合了2014—2024年间113个监测站的年度观测数据与多源辅助栅格数据，包括气溶胶光学厚度、气象变量、土地利用/覆盖数据、夜间灯光、高程和人口密度。利用2014—2023年数据训练了随机森林、长短期记忆网络和XGBoost模型，并使用2024年站点观测数据进行独立评估。XGBoost取得了最佳整体性能，PM2.5和NO2的R²值分别为0.71和0.81，因此被用于生成2024年1公里分辨率的基线污染物浓度表面。随后训练了两个生成对抗网络（GAN）模型，将土地利用图像转换为XGBoost估算的污染物地图，从而支持涉及植被、建设用地和水体配置的情景实验。在探索性模式响应而非因果分析的前提下，情景分析结果表明，多种土地利用布局与模型估算的局部污染物浓度下降相关。本研究提供了一种数据驱动的方法，用于联合污染物制图和土地利用规划情景的初步筛选，同时强调未来工作中需利用观测到的土地利用变化进行验证。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象明确为四川盆地，属于中国地区，且数据来自中国监测站，制度背景和核心应用均与中国直接相关。
title: An XGBoost-GAN framework for mapping PM2.5 and NO2 and exploring land-use scenarios in the Sichuan Basin
title_zh: 基于XGBoost-GAN框架的四川盆地PM2.5与NO2制图及土地利用情景探索

abstract: I study redistribution between inactive, unemployed, and employed agents who are heterogeneous in their preferences and their productive skills in the labor market and at home. The government considers that redistribution across skills is desirable, but redistribution across preferences is not: if everyone has the same preferences, equality is optimal, but if everyone has the same skills, laissez-faire is optimal. In turn, this leads to a simple sufficient statistic to assess any reform: any extra dollar of transfer should go to the agent whose consumption is the furthest below what she would have consumed if everyone had average skills. In high-income countries, the gap between the lowest consumption and the average production is empirically much larger in the labor market than among inactives. Hence, introducing an inactivity benefit, or basic income, would neither be welfare-improving nor optimal for that social welfare function, regardless of labor supply elasticities.
abstract_zh: 我研究的是在劳动力市场与家庭中，偏好和生产技能均存在异质性的非活跃、失业及就业个体之间的再分配问题。政府认为，跨技能再分配是可取的，但跨偏好再分配则不然：若所有人偏好相同，则平等为最优；若所有人技能相同，则自由放任为最优。由此，这引出了一个简单的充分统计量来评估任何改革：每一额外转移支付的美元应流向消费水平最低于其若拥有平均技能时所应消费水平的个体。在高收入国家中，最低消费与平均产出之间的差距在劳动力市场中实证上远大于非活跃群体。因此，引入非活跃津贴或基本收入，无论劳动供给弹性如何，既不会改善福利，也不符合该社会福利函数下的最优状态。
title: Basic income versus fairness: redistribution with inactive agents
title_zh: 基本收入与公平：非活跃主体下的再分配
